subject.title: fix(infra): bound stalled provider JSON/text/binary response reads with default chunk timeout

question: Should provider response-body idle timeouts automatically respect an explicit models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds value, or should the shared helpers always impose fixed 30-second success-body and 10-second error-body ceilings?
rationale: Both approaches prevent indefinite reads, but only maintainers can define whether the existing operator-selected timeout also governs silence after response headers and whether error diagnostics may be truncated after 10 seconds.

options.title: Honor the provider budget
options.body: Thread the resolved provider/request timeout into body reads and use 30/10-second fallbacks only when no explicit budget exists.

options.title: Accept fixed helper ceilings
options.body: Land the fixed defaults after explicitly documenting that they are lower idle ceilings independent of provider timeoutSeconds and proving upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep timeouts caller-owned
options.body: Expose the new options but remove shared defaults, then apply explicit budgets only at audited provider call sites.

recommendation.title: Honor the provider budget
recommendation.body: Thread the resolved provider/request timeout into body reads and use 30/10-second fallbacks only when no explicit budget exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history signal on the shared provider response helper contract being changed.
